method: Each term queried separately so each monthly series is scaled by Google Trends to its own 0-100 peak. The saved response is a current API/UI historical export, not the January 22, 2017 response used by the book.
limitations: Google Trends is sampled and dynamically revised.
Low-volume historical months may be returned as zero.
The original export date and exact smoothing parameters cannot be recreated from the book citation alone.
